delete.title: Delete link
delete.titleMany: Delete {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}
delete.description: Short URLs stop working immediately. You can restore these links from Trash for 30 days.
consequences: The short link stops redirecting immediately; printed copies stop working.
Its keys stay reserved for 30 days.
Campaign and bio references are kept for restoration; the link is hidden from public bio pages.
After 30 days, the link is permanently removed. Aggregate analytics remain.
delete.confirmMany: Delete {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}
delete.notAllowed: You can only delete links you created.

utm.title: UTM variants
utm.description: Tagged versions of this link for each channel. Clicks are counted per source, medium and campaign.

hints.source: Where the traffic comes from, e.g. newsletter, facebook.
hints.medium: The channel type, e.g. email, social.
hints.campaign: Groups the link into a campaign with the same name.

utm.deleteDescription: Review the variant before removing it.
utm.deleteConsequence: This variant is removed from the saved list. Previously shared URLs keep redirecting and their analytics remain available.
utm.deleteCampaignConsequence: If this was the link’s last variant in a campaign, the link leaves that campaign. Empty campaigns are deleted.
utm.changed: The variants have changed since you opened this page. Return to the variants list and review the current version.
utm.defaultsHint: Choose a saved campaign to see its defaults. You can also enter your own values.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted links stop redirecting immediately. Restore them within 30 days to keep their keys, settings, campaigns and bio references. Selections stay with you across pages and filters in this tab.

trash.failed: Links could not be restored. Check your permissions and try again.
trash.partial: {count, plural, one {# selected link could not be restored.} other {# selected links could not be restored.}} It may have expired or your permissions may have changed. Clear the selection to continue.
trash.restored: {count, plural, one {# link restored.} other {# links restored.}}
